title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
summary: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren and Jian Sun submitted Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition to arXiv on December 10, 2015. The paper presents a residual-learning framework in which layers learn residual functions with reference to their inputs, and reports experiments with residual networks up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A documented computer-vision research milestone for residual learning as a method for training substantially deeper neural networks.

verification.note: The December 10 2015 date is scoped only to the original arXiv submission milestone. The authors, residual-learning formulation and reported 152-layer ImageNet experiments are supported by the paper and corroborated by Microsoft Research's publication record. This record does not infer a system birth date, software/model release date, development geography, ancestry, influence, causality or relationships.
